description: Subtitle checker and converter (SRT/VTT) — Validate, fix, retime and convert subtitles. Pass text= (SRT or WebVTT content) or url= (an .srt or .vtt file, e.g. a Whisper transcript). Checks every cue against streaming style limits: overlaps, out-of-order or zero/negative durations, reading speed (max_cps, default 20 chars/sec), line length (max_chars, default 42), more than 2 lines, under 833 ms or over 7 s on screen, gaps under 2 frames, duplicate consecutive cues, broken numbering; verdict CLEAN / MINOR ISSUES / NEEDS FIXES. Options: shift_ms (+/- milliseconds), fps_from + fps_to (frame-rate retime, e.g. 25 to 23.976) or scale, fix=1 (sort, drop empty cues, repair bad durations, trim overlaps), to = json | srt | vtt | text (converted file in output; text = clean transcript without tags or repeats), limit (cues listed in json mode, default 100). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
